headline: GOLD CRASHES TO $4,500 AS MIDDLE EAST OIL SHOCK RULES OUT FED CUTS FOR 2026
snippet: Spot gold dropped 3% to $4,500/oz on May 15 as Middle East energy costs drove the worst US inflation print of the year, pushing investors to abandon Fed rate-cut bets entirely for 2026; silver shed 7% and copper fell 3% in the same session before partial recovery — gold sits at $4,537 today, down 5.9% on the month despite remaining 40% above a year ago.

headline: LUNDIN-BACKED NGEX HITS 1,740 g/t GOLD OVER 2 METRES AT LUNAHUASI, ARGENTINA
snippet: NGEx Minerals' Phase 4 program at its 100%-owned Lunahuasi copper-gold-silver deposit in San Juan, Argentina returned hole DPDH070: 17.3m at 207.79 g/t Au including 2.00m at a staggering 1,740 g/t Au from ~335m depth; two ultra-high-grade gold vein zones are now confirmed 660m apart, proving the high-grade gold component is widespread across the deposit — not a single pocket.

headline: MERIDIAN MINING FINDS GOLD AT ÁLAMO — 1KM FROM SANTA HELENA PROCESSING INFRASTRUCTURE
snippet: Meridian Mining (TSX: MNO) announced a new gold and base-metal discovery at Álamo, just 1km from its Santa Helena VMS infrastructure in Brazil's Cabaçal belt; exploration hole CD-852 returned 3.5m at 2.4 g/t Au, 0.5% Cu, 9.5 g/t Ag, and 0.7% Zn from 108.9m — the highest gold grade intersected in this footwall position to date, open along a 1.6km IP anomaly.

headline: BARRICK Q1 EARNINGS SURGE 180%, ADDS $3B BUYBACK, PLANS NORTH AMERICAN IPO SPLIT
snippet: Barrick Mining's Q1 2026 results delivered adjusted EPS of $0.98 — up 180% year-over-year — on gold production of 719,000 oz (above guidance) and operating cash flow of $2.55B (+111% YoY); the company simultaneously announced a new $3B share buyback and confirmed it is advancing an IPO of North American Barrick (Nevada Gold Mines + Pueblo Viejo) by year-end 2026.

headline: HUDBAY'S $1.48B ARIZONA SONORAN COPPER DEAL CLEARS COURT; Q2 2026 CLOSE EXPECTED
snippet: The Supreme Court of British Columbia granted the final order for Hudbay Minerals' C$1.48B all-share acquisition of Arizona Sonoran Copper after 99% of securityholders voted in favour; the deal creates North America's third-largest copper district by combining Hudbay's existing operations with the Cactus open-pit copper project in Arizona, with closing expected in Q2 2026.

headline: BRAZIL ANTITRUST WATCHDOG PROBES USA RARE EARTH'S $2.8B SERRA VERDE ACQUISITION
snippet: Brazil's CADE antitrust authority opened proceedings to assess whether USA Rare Earth's $2.8B acquisition of Serra Verde Group — the only scaled producer of all four magnetic rare earths (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb) outside Asia — requires formal notification under competition law; the probe does not automatically block the deal, but a Q3 2026 CADE determination is now the key milestone to watch.

headline: SILVER DEFICIT DEEPENS FOR 6TH STRAIGHT YEAR: CHINA SOLAR ABSORBS 20% OF GLOBAL SUPPLY
snippet: The silver market is tracking its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3M oz as solar PV manufacturing — now 29% of total industrial silver demand vs. 11% in 2014 — dominates demand growth; silver is up 134% year-over-year at $75.91/oz despite a 7% pullback in last week's inflation selloff, with the market-wide structural shortage underpinning the multi-year bull case.

headline: RARE EARTHS AMERICAS SURGES ON NYSE DEBUT; $63M RAISED FOR US HEAVY RARE EARTH PLAY
snippet: Rare Earths Americas listed on NYSE American in an oversubscribed IPO that raised $63.3M at a $368M valuation, with proceeds aimed at advancing four exploration-stage heavy rare earth projects in Brazil and the US; the company targets dysprosium and terbium — the two highest-value elements for EV motor magnets — at a time when NdPr oxide prices have already pulled back 21% from their Q1 2026 peak.

headline: COPPER'S JUNE 30 DEADLINE: US MAY IMPOSE 15% TARIFF IN 2027, 30% IN 2028 ON REFINED IMPORTS
snippet: The US Secretary of Commerce must deliver a Section 232 report on domestic copper markets by June 30, 2026, after which the President can determine whether to implement a 15% universal duty on refined copper from 2027 rising to 30% from 2028; copper fell 4.81% to $6.25/lb on May 15 in the broader metals selloff, though J.P. Morgan projects a 330,000-tonne 2026 refined copper shortfall from AI and grid demand.

headline: MINING M&A HITS 13-YEAR HIGH: $21.6B IN Q1 AS SUPPLY CHAIN LOGIC OVERTAKES VALUATION
snippet: Global mining M&A in Q1 2026 totalled $21.6B — 34% above Q1 2025 — as securing critical mineral supply chains replaced pure valuation arbitrage as the primary deal rationale; gold and silver assets dominated at 77% of January volume, while full-year 2025 hit $93.7B, the highest annual total since 2012 and a clear signal of intensifying sector consolidation.

headline: BARRICK AT 'THE $5,000 GOLD MIRAGE': ANALYST WARNS CURRENT VALUATION HAS NO MARGIN OF SAFETY
snippet: A contrarian Seeking Alpha analysis rates Barrick Mining a Sell despite record Q1 2026 results — arguing that forward EV/EBIT multiples only look attractive if gold sustains ~$5,000/oz, and with gold now trading at $4,537 post-selloff, the margin of safety has vanished; the author prefers waiting for a more compelling entry point before adding to a position in the world's second-largest gold miner.

headline: URANIUM BREAKS $100/LB AS NEXGEN ROOK I — NORTH AMERICA'S BIGGEST MINE — NEARS CONSTRUCTION
snippet: Uranium spot has broken back above $100/lb as utility demand re-emerges after years of under-contracting, with Sprott projecting spot convergence toward $120–$140; NexGen Energy is simultaneously finalizing preparations to begin construction of Rook I in northern Saskatchewan this summer — a 29.6M lb/yr project that would become the top uranium mine by output in North America.
